profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Tandem Diabetes Care
profile.summary:
Engineer and leader passionate about building technology that improves health outcomes. 
I design and deliver complex, safety-critical systems that serve hundreds of thousands of users daily—and I thrive at the intersection of technical depth, strategic vision, and cross-functional collaboration. As a Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead at Tandem Diabetes Care, I’ve led teams developing FDA-regulated insulin pump software, designed secure data APIs, and driven quality improvements across an ecosystem of connected medical devices. My work bridges engineering rigor with human-centered design, translating between technical, clinical, and product domains to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that have an impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Software Platforms
positions.description: Leading process and infrastructure changes to support high quality Insulin Pump software across hardware platforms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead - CGM Integrations
Excited to be working with my team to integrate new CGM (Continuous Glucose Monitors) with our insulin pump!

positions.title: Incoming Software Engineer (rescinded due to COVID-19)
President
positions.description:
Working to oversee the 300 member organization, containing 10 project teams working to design and build sustainable, community focused, technology.

Led organization-wide restructure, giving each individual project team more autonomy and accountability.

company.name: BLUElab at the University of Michigan

positions.title: Project Jason - Software for Accessibility
positions.description: Worked with group of students at the University of Michigan to develop a communication app for nonverbal children with autism. Using react native and Django, we implemented a mobile app with searchable, sharable, image card libraries to make communication easier between non verbal children and their families and care takers.

company.name: University of Michigan College of Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As an intern on Redfin's Mortgage Team, I created a mortgage rate quoting platform to boost efficiency on a per loan basis-- making applying for a loan with Redfin speedier than ever. 

I collaborated with my team to create proof of concept for a grammar free expression language, making mortgage software fully configurable by Mortgage Operations team.

positions.title: Program Development Intern
positions.description: Creating programming for experiential learning for students at U of M. Creating web content and newsletters focusing on socially engaged design activity on campus at the University of Michigan.

company.name: The Center for Socially Engaged Design

positions.title: External Committee Chair
positions.description: Serving on the executive board for the socially engaged design organization, BLUElab. My role included facilitation workshops, mentoring project teams through the design process and managing BLUElab's relationship with sponsoring corporations and the University.

positions.title: Discovery Team Member
positions.description: Working with student team to design low cost turbidity sensors for use in water treatment systems.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description: Doing both front and back end web development, I worked alongside a team of students to design, implement, and test new website features.
